title: Aurora Dashboard Hero
description: Dark SaaS hero with violet-teal aurora glow, announcement pill and a support-inbox mockup whose agent reply streams in.

title: Editorial Serif Hero
description: Warm cream fintech hero with an italic serif headline and a tilted collage of card, balance and invoice widgets.

title: Terminal Typing Hero
description: Developer-tool hero with a looping terminal that types deploy commands, plus a copyable install command.

title: Gradient Orb Waitlist Hero
description: Centered light hero with a soft floating gradient orb, validated email capture and an avatar social-proof stack.

title: AI Chat Preview Hero
description: Lavender split hero with marker-highlighted headline and a chat window that plays an AI conversation in sequence.

title: Logo Cloud and Stats Band
description: Infinite marquee of fictional SVG wordmarks with edge fades, above a hairline stats band that counts up.

title: Bento Feature Section
description: Dark bento grid of mini visualizations: uptime bars, globe arcs, code, live toggles and a latency chart, with cursor glow.

title: Process Timeline Section
description: Four-step onboarding timeline alternating left and right, with a center line that fills as you scroll.

title: Floating Pill Navbar
description: Light, blurred floating pill navbar with a product mega-menu dropdown, shrink-on-scroll and a mobile panel.

title: Dark Navbar with Mobile Menu
description: Dark navbar with dismissible announcement bar, sliding hover indicator, command-K search and a full-screen mobile menu.

title: Feature Icon Grid
description: Clean six-cell feature grid with gradient icon tiles, hairline dividers and hover tints.

title: Alternating Feature Rows
description: Warm-black feature rows alternating text and HTML-built mockups: kanban, calendar and analytics funnel.

title: Tabbed Feature Showcase
description: Four-tab feature showcase with sliding indicator, auto-advance progress and a distinct product mockup per tab.

title: Three-Tier Pricing with Toggle
description: Dark three-tier pricing with a working monthly/annual switch, animated prices and a gradient-bordered popular plan.

title: Plan Comparison Table
description: Four-plan comparison table with sticky plan headers, collapsible feature groups and a tinted recommended column.

title: Testimonial Masonry Wall
description: Masonry wall of customer quotes with highlighted phrases, metric callouts and a fade-out show-more reveal.

title: Large Quote Carousel
description: Single large serif quote carousel on deep ink with working arrows, dots, keyboard control and paused autoplay.

title: Newsletter Footer
description: Dark multi-column footer with a validated newsletter signup, status pill and an oversized cropped wordmark.

title: Aurora Mesh Background
description: Full-viewport drifting aurora of blurred teal, violet and magenta blobs with film grain and a centered headline.

title: Grid Spotlight Background
description: Fine dark grid with an eased, cursor-following spotlight that reveals a brighter colored grid beneath.

title: Noise and Radial Glow Background
description: Warm paper-grain background with a breathing apricot radial glow, a cool counter-glow and a serif headline.

title: Gradient Beam Buttons
description: Buttons with an animated conic light beam travelling around the border, in primary, outline, pill and icon variants.

title: Magnetic Pill Buttons
description: Pill buttons that drift toward the cursor with parallax labels and spring back on leave.

title: Shimmer CTA Buttons
description: Call-to-action set with shine sweep, shimmer border, sliding arrow and a working loading-to-success state.

title: Split and Segmented Buttons
description: Split buttons with working dropdown menus that update the action, plus a single-select segmented icon group.

title: Glass Profile Card
description: Frosted glass designer profile on a vivid blurred backdrop, with stats, skill chips and a follow toggle.

title: Product Tilt Cards
description: Three hardware product cards with 3D pointer tilt, moving glare, color swatches and add-to-bag toggles.

title: Stat Metric Cards
description: KPI cards with SVG sparklines and trend badges, driven by a 7d / 30d / 90d range switch.

title: Waitlist Form with Validation
description: Signup card with live per-field error and success states, a loading submit and a waitlist confirmation screen.

title: Animated Heading Treatments
description: Three headline animations on one panel: word blur-rise reveal, sweeping gradient text and spring letter stagger.

title: Wordmark Set
description: Presentation canvas of six original SVG wordmark concepts on light and dark tiles, each with a style note.

title: Monogram and Lockup Sheet
description: Brand sheet with a monogram mark, horizontal and stacked lockups, clear-space guide and copyable color swatches.
